status: new prospective comparative programme frozen after v10 boundary result and before discovery of any new candidate vertical outcomes
motivation: v10 shows that centered vertical individuality is recurrent but not universal, and that horizontal site fidelity and centered vertical organization can dissociate. The next question is what predicts expression versus absence across independent systems.

historical_sources.role: historical anchors only; they motivate the programme but are not counted as new prospective source replicates

repositories: Movebank Data Repository / published Movebank studies with public downloadable event data
closed_search_universe.search_rule: screen all unique datasets returned by the frozen query set in the search snapshot; do not stop after finding a favorable candidate

required: a source vertical field whose presence and semantics can be established without reading numeric vertical values
at least potentially repeated observations from multiple individuals
exclude: known duplicate/republication of an already-opened source
vertical values visible only in a figure with no raw event data
source whose species/individual identity cannot be resolved outcome-blind

forbidden_before_vertical_opening: parse, summarize or plot numeric altitude/height
select sources or subsets based on vertical effect
alter session/fix/support thresholds after vertical outcome
rank candidate sources by expected vertical individuality

source_level_vertical_design.default_horizontal_projection: appropriate local metric CRS frozen per source before vertical opening
source_level_vertical_design.session_centering: subtract full retained session median of the source vertical field
source_level_vertical_design.self_profile: equal other eligible sessions of same individual
source_level_vertical_design.other_profile: pool sessions within each other individual then equal-weight other individuals
source_level_vertical_design.common_cell_weighting: identical self-derived common-cell weights for self and other profiles
source_level_vertical_design.null: whole-session identity permutation within the narrowest source-native taxon/cohort stratum frozen before vertical opening
source_level_vertical_design.source_primary_estimand: observed common-cell centered identity minus permutation-null mean
source_level_vertical_design.source_primary_pass: calibrated excess > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

horizontal_axis_metric.purpose: quantify horizontal individuality without using vertical outcomes, so spatial axes can be compared prospectively
horizontal_axis_metric.metric: held-out same-individual versus other-individual predictive advantage for 5-km horizontal-cell occupancy using whole-session identity permutation
horizontal_axis_metric.timing: must be computed and frozen before numeric vertical values are opened for each new source

comparative_questions.Q1: How heterogeneous is centered vertical-individuality effect size across new independent bat tracking sources?
comparative_questions.Q2: Do horizontal identity and centered vertical identity occupy the same axis, or can their calibrated effects dissociate prospectively?
comparative_questions.Q3: Which predeclared ecological trait families should be tested in a later stage as predictors of centered vertical individuality expression?

cross_source_rules.if_new_sources_lt_5: report source-level effects and horizontal-vs-vertical bivariate positions descriptively; do not fit cross-source predictor models
cross_source_rules.if_new_sources_ge_5: report median and range of calibrated vertical excess and fraction positive; no population-general p-value is claimed from convenience-source sampling
cross_source_rules.if_new_sources_ge_8: a separately frozen stage-2 contract may test at most one primary cross-source predictor family plus one horizontal-axis covariate; predictor choice must be frozen before opening stage-2 vertical outcomes

candidate_predictor_families_for_future_: flight morphology: wing loading and aspect ratio
foraging / flight guild and clutter regime
claim_boundary: This programme is not a rescue of Nyctalus or Hipposideros.
Historical opened sources may be displayed as anchors but cannot count as new prospective validation sources.
A new source FAIL is retained and does not trigger source replacement or alternate endpoint selection.
The programme asks why vertical individuality varies across systems, not whether every source can be made positive.
